summary.text: Nick Fosness is a Republican state representative who has represented South Dakota House District 1 since his appointment in August 2025 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026.

According to Ballotpedia, he is chief executive officer of Avera's Marshall County Hospital Healthcare Center and faces Republican Daniel Kjos and Democrat Courtney Enfield for the district's two seats.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia reports that Nick Fosness serves on the Britton-Hecla School District board.
It says Governor Larry Rhoden appointed him to the House on August 5, 2025, to replace Christopher Reder, and that he advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary.
